title: primula denticulata subsp. sinodenticulata
intro:
Primula denticulata subsp. sinodenticulata, commonly known as the Himalayan cowslip or blue cowslip, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the primrose family, characterized by its unique blue or white flowers and native to the Himalayan region.

This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as digestive problems, fever, and inflammation, due to its health benefits of aiding in digestion and relieving fever. The therapeutic actions of Primula denticulata subsp. sinodenticulata include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which help in soothing the digestive system and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
